        nonpadding_ids = item_ids[item_ids.ne(0)]
        embeddings = model.item_emb(nonpadding_ids)
        squared_norm_sum = squared_norm_sum + embeddings.square().sum()
        embedding_count = embedding_count + nonpadding_ids.numel()
    norm_penalty = squared_norm_sum / embedding_count.clamp(min=1.0)
    return prediction_loss + 1e-4 * norm_penalty
